## What it is

Boîtier de l'alimentation 24 V, 96 W (68,5 × 44,1 × 25,8 mm, `alim24_*`), qui remplace `boitier_ps` (RECOM RAC05-05SK) sans ps_upstream. L'alimentation est sur sa tranche à l'ouest, plaque alu contre le mur ouest, composants, VH et bornier vers l'est ; VH au sud, bornier 24 V au nord. À l'est, deux Wago 221-415 sur leur tranche, ouvertures vers le sud, pour L et N (arrivée, alimentation, LED de façade, combined). Au nord, le CAN et le 5 V entre combined (est) et l'écran (ouest) traversent le boîtier sur le fond, sous les fils 24 V. Plaqué par deux aimants contre la face interne ouest de la machine, fond contre la face. Couvercle PETG transparent à venir : deux pions Ø 2,4 entreront dans les trous M3 taraudés du flanc haut, à 3,5 mm des coins nord-est et sud-est de l'alimentation.

## Design notes

Origin at the inner south-west corner, Z from the bed. Every coordinate comes from `disposition()`; the layout follows David's sections of 2026-11-03:

- X: wall 1.68, air 1.0 (`air_ouest`), supply 25.8, gap 2.5 (`ecart_alim_wago`), Wago support wall 1.68, two `wago_epaisseur` 8.4, east wall 1.68. Outer 51.14.
- Y: south wall 1.68, 8 mm (`passage_fils_sud`, south muret included: AC wires turning north to the Wago), supply 68.5, 15 mm (`passage_fils_nord`, 22 mm wall included: bend of the 24 V wires), north wall 1.68. Outer 94.86.
- Z: floor 1.6, air 1.0 (`air_fond`), supply 44.1, air 1.0 (`air_couvercle`). Walls 47.7 from the bed; with the 1.6 mm lid, 49.3, under the 50 mm available.

Supply holders, all press-fit with no clearance on the open ends of the U:

- Two vertical ribs 1 mm (`air_ouest`) × 1.68 on the west wall at 10 % and 90 % of the supply length, up to 4 mm under the rim (lid rim).
- Two floor rails at the same Y, 1 mm high (`air_fond`) under the lower flank, prolonged 2.5 mm east of the supply and raised to 4 mm (`hauteur_berceau`): the cradle lip.
- South muret 1.68 × 4 mm (`hauteur_muret_sud`) across the supply width, against its end.
- North wall 1.68 × 22 mm (`hauteur_mur_nord`) across the full inner width, against the supply's north end. The 24 V terminal is centred 29 mm from the lower flank edge (`alim24_bornier_centre`, pitch 5): the lower wire sits at 28.0 mm from the bed, the wall top at 23.6. `reject` refuses a wall that reaches the wire. The CAN and 5 V wires run on the floor north of this wall, from the north-east slot to the north-west one; the 24 V wires pass over it and leave by the north-east slot.

Wago bay, centred in Y on the cavity (`decalage_wago_nord` moves it): south sill 1.68 thick, 1 mm above the rails (`hauteur_seuil_wago`); terminals 18.6 deep (`wago_profondeur`), no clearance (press-fit test, as in the PETG boxes); north wall and west support wall up to the catch, 2 + 30 + 2 mm above the floor. Two X-rails 2 mm (`hauteur_rails_wago`) under the terminals, 5 mm off the sill and the north wall: the machine face runs at 40–50 °C. One 1 mm catch with a 45° underside along the whole bay, on the south face of the north wall, the tip's lower face 1 mm above the terminals (same convention as `boitier_ps`).

Two Ø 8.2 magnet wells (`add_well`, 0.6 mm skin) against the east wall, 5 mm (`recul_puits`) south of the sill and north of the bay's north wall, clear of the Wago entries. The bore bites 0.2 mm into the east wall (`_MORSURE_PUIT`): an exactly tangent bore leaves slivers. The bite leaves two 0.5 mm² ceilings above the magnet in the wall, the one `sliver` warning, harmless.

Four 5 mm slots open to the rim (wires slid in from the top): west at the south corner (machine in, LED out) and south at the east corner (combined AC), both from 15 mm above the floor (`seuil_ouvertures_sud`); east and west at the north corner (24 V out east; CAN + 5 V through), both down to the floor. 0.6 mm chamfer on their jambs and sills.

Two M2.5 lid corbels (`INSERT_M25`, 45°): on the north wall 3 mm east of the north-west slot; on the south wall 3 mm west of the south-east slot, so the wires slide under it.

Polish: 1 mm on the four outer vertical corners, 0.6 mm on the slot edges.

## Don't

- Do not add clearance to the supply murets, ribs or the Wago bay: press-fit at the measured sizes for this first print (user 2026-11-03).
- Do not add the murets to `passage_fils_sud` / `passage_fils_nord`: the passages include them (user 2026-11-03, after a first cut that added them).
- Do not add a closed CAN channel with its own wall inside `passage_fils_nord`: the 24 V bend needs the full 15 mm to the north wall, and the channel would come on top (tried 2026-11-03, 101.5 mm in Y, reverted).
- Do not fuse the magnet wells to the sill or to the bay's north wall: 5 mm off, clear of the Wago entries.
- Do not run the slots short of the rim: the wires are slid in from the top.
- Do not run the south slots to the floor; do run the north ones to it.
- Do not put the corbels in the corners: every corner has a slot.
- Do not move the magnet wells off the east wall: the 1.68 mm wall is their east side.
- Do not put a metal screw through the lid into the supply: pins, since the aluminium plate is not reliably insulated and the box sits on the earthed face.
- Do not edit `boitier_ps` for this supply: `couvercle_ps` and `ensemble_boitier_ps` still depend on it.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```
